features.title: W0 — Longhorn Cleanup
features.why: Remove every Longhorn object from the cluster and the repository, and leave a written record of which applications now need a fresh configuration.

features.title: W5 — Platform Upgrades
features.why: Move the cluster from K3s 1.30.1 and Traefik 2.9.4 to K3s 1.36.x and Traefik v3, through a rehearsed procedure, with the same ACME certificate and no unplanned ingress outage.

features.title: PostgreSQL W2
features.why: Replace the dead Bitnami PostgreSQL and the broken pgAdmin with an owned chart running PostgreSQL 18 on local-path, a network policy, nightly dumps, and a LAN-only pgAdmin — with no application database created ahead of need.

features.title: AshuLab Logo
features.why: Produce the AshuLab mark — three nodes in a triangle whose top node forms the crossbar of an "A", on a round badge — as a vector master plus the PNG exports the login page, Discord server and favicon need.

features.title: Authentik phase 1 — repave the instance
features.why: Authentik runs on chart 2026.8.5 with an empty, dedicated database, serves its hostname with a valid certificate, applies its configuration from blueprints in git, and the operator can sign in as the local administrator.

features.title: Authentik phase 2 — Discord and Plex as sign-in sources
features.why: A person can sign in to authentik with Discord or Plex. Discord admits only members of the homelab server; Plex admits the owner and anyone the AshuFlex server is shared with. Both land in users.

features.title: Authentik phase 3 — Argo CD, Grafana, pgAdmin, Kavita
features.why: These four applications authenticate through authentik, and only people in users get in. Discord and Plex remain the ways to sign in to authentik itself.

features.title: Bazarr chart refactor
features.why: Replace the two dead Bazarr instances' stalled remote chart with two local charts that follow the repo contract, switch both ArgoCD Applications to them, and record the two API keys in homelab.env for the day the exporter is enabled.

features.title: Books library (CWA + Kavita)
features.why: Replace the Calibre desktop container with Calibre-Web Automated (CWA) as the single library UI, and rebuild the Kavita chart so the reader runs again on 0.9.1, both over the existing NFS library.

features.title: Cross-seed chart refactor
features.why: Rebuild the cross-seed Helm chart around the image's actual needs, using the repo chart contract and the autobrr chart as a reference for principles, then correct the documentation so the reference is no longer presented as a directory to copy.

features.title: Documentation site
features.why: One internal hostname, docs.kub.local, serving every repository's docs/ folder for main and develop, rebuilt within a minute of a merge, with no commit to maintain and no GitHub Actions minute spent.

features.title: FileBrowser Namespace Move
features.why: Move FileBrowser from media-stack to its own filebrowser namespace, rebuilt as a local wrapper chart with fresh local-path config/database, the same three NFS media exports, and its own login.

features.title: Lidarr chart refactor
features.why: Rebuild the Lidarr Helm chart on the repo's contract so the app starts on a working config claim, exports metrics, and keeps its LAN-only route.

features.title: Maintainerr chart refactor
features.why: Rebuild the Maintainerr Helm chart on the repo's contract so the app starts on a claim the chart creates, is reachable on the LAN only, and reports its health honestly.

features.title: Media dashboard
features.why: Add a Homelab · Media dashboard to Grafana that answers "what is the media stack doing, and where is it stuck?" from the exporters enabled on 2026-11-13.

features.title: Media stack security — Phase 0
features.why: Stop every non-public route in the cluster from answering the internet, and make a future route that forgets the gate fail a repository check.

features.title: Media tools behind authentik
features.why: Put authentik's forward-auth gate in front of autobrr, bazarr, sonarr, lidarr, radarr, qbittorrent, maintainerr, prowlarr and tautulli, one application at a time, starting with Sonarr.

features.title: Observability after the media chart repairs — follow-up plan
features.why: Close the four findings from the 2026-11-13 observability inspection that are not already fixed: the unverified streaming temperature alert, the missing workload-down alert for media-stack, the qBittorrent DNS gap that breaks the cross-seed hook, and the app-side misconfigurations the rebuilt charts expose.

features.title: Observability stack
features.why: Replace the broken vendored Prometheus and Grafana charts and the never-deployed Loki directory with four owned wrapper charts, each taking the project's current official chart as a pinned dependency, exposing Grafana, Prometheus and Loki on .kub.local and shipping container logs with Fluent Bit.

features.title: Radarr and radarr-anime chart refactor
features.why: Rebuild the radarr and radarr-anime charts to the hand-maintained chart contract, on the prowlarr shape, with named media mounts, /ping probes, warn logging, correct sizing, a working exportarr wiring, and radarr-anime no longer running its app as root.

features.title: Recyclarr chart refactor
features.why: Rebuild the recyclarr Helm chart as a contract-compliant CronJob: values that drive the render, the Secret mounted where the app reads it, the existing config claim kept and named from the release, and documentation that records what is deliberately absent.

features.title: Seerr chart refactor
features.why: Rebuild cluster/helm/media-stack/seerr on the repo chart contract and the Plex public-route shape, preserving every live object name.

features.title: Sonarr and sonarr-anime chart refactor
features.why: Rebuild the sonarr and sonarr-anime charts on the repo chart contract, bump Sonarr to 4.0.20.3014-ls4, size memory from measurement, add warn logging and /ping probes, and fix the exporter target that has pointed at port 7878 since it was written.

features.title: SSO access model
features.why: Give the homelab three access levels (admin, user, guest) enforced by authentik groups, one capability-gated application (FileBrowser folder access), and optional MFA that actually applies on Discord and Plex logins.

features.title: Tautulli chart refactor
features.why: Rebuild the Tautulli Helm chart on the repo's contract so the app starts on a working config claim and is reachable on the LAN only.

features.title: Unpackerr chart refactor
features.why: Rebuild the unpackerr Helm chart to the repo chart contract, take the image from 0.16.1 to v1.0.1, and remove the four API keys from git.

features.title: Vikunja task board
features.why: Stand up Vikunja in the cluster as the single place task state lives, wire it to the agents over its own MCP endpoint, and make the operator's only job a review queue.
